findings.title: Bed source accepts a value borrowed from ID in same header
findings.reproducer: source header Paciente Rex, leito 1, ID 2; model bed 2; evidence leito 1, ID 2
findings.actual: issues=[], provider preview accepted; exact author token confirms task open and bed 2 eligible memory; reopen unchanged
findings.mechanism: Marker trims quote only at leito, but does not delimit ID; numeric substring ID value satisfies bed output.

findings.title: Unit prefix is accepted as exact unit
findings.reproducer: source Evolução: dose 1 mg/kg; model evolucao dose 1 mg; literal evidence Evolução: dose 1 mg/kg
findings.expected: blocking VALUE_UNIT_MISMATCH; no derived task activation
findings.actual: issues=[], exact author confirmation creates open task; confirmed edited clinical field persists after reopen
findings.mechanism: numericText(local).includes(numericText(value)) accepts truncated literal unit; compareSourceValue exact tuple oracle is not used by runtime validator.

findings.title: Generic ok eligibility path is missing
findings.reproducer: single same-author current draft, whole accepted preview, no earlier pending note/correction; real ok webhook
findings.expected: confirm under SPEC §3 unambiguous simple-confirmation contract
findings.actual: asks for exact token; draft/task unchanged; two POSTs (preview and refusal response)
findings.mechanism: Unconditional no-token return; existing first-vertical suite encodes blanket rejection rather than eligibility.

findings.title: Permanent correction failure clears pending replacement
findings.reproducer: confirm original, valid correction admission, static organizer throws schema_invalid
findings.expected: old revision replacement_pending with old open tasks suspended until successful replacement
findings.actual: old revision superseded, replacementPending false, old task cancelled, new raw draft; reopen unchanged
findings.mechanism: Permanent/exhausted organizer error goes through normal #draft/replacement_prepared success transition; only transient retry retains pending state.
